description.value: Youbou Bar & Grill is a lakeside pub and restaurant in the small village of Youbou on the shores of Lake Cowichan, serving scratch-made food built around locally sourced ingredients. The kitchen is led by a named chef and the menu spans burgers, wood-fired pizza, wings, and seasonal specials, with regular live music events tying it to the local community. Positioned just minutes from Laketown Ranch and near area hiking and paddling, it doubles as a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the Cowichan Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is real, open year-round, and operating as a lakeside bar and grill at 10524 Youbou Road, Youbou, BC. Phone +1 (778) 429-8088 and address are clearly stated on the website but the OSM record carries no phone field to cross-check. Takeout is explicitly offered ('Take-out Orders Available by Calling Ahead'); dietary flexibility is stated on the About page ('Dietary flexibility for allergies, sensitivities, and preferences'). No bike parking, washroom, water, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone +1 (778) 429-8088 sourced from website only.

Email address inconsistency within the website itself: contact page shows 'info@youboubargrill.ca' while the footer on several pages shows 'info@youbougrill.ca' (missing 'bar'). Likely a copy-paste error on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, year-round business with a functioning website, confirmed address, and active menu. A natural stopping point for cyclists on the Lake Cowichan loop.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About page states 'Dietary flexibility for allergies, sensitivities, and preferences' as a kitchen principle

wow_evidence: scratch-made food built around locally sourced ingredients
